tasks.title: Measure comparison filters: contract, canonical ingress, authorization union, HAVING in both domains, derived totals
tasks.objective: Give the selection contract an additive optional measureFilters list (measure vs measure or vs a fixed-scale decimal value; gt, gte, lt, lte; AND; order-preserving) and build the trust spine under it: one pure helper that normalises, canonicalises and appends operand measures; one typed exception; the operand union read by validation, executor authorization, saved and pin runnable status and the pin definition-version hash; the SQL builder compiling each filter to HAVING over verified expressions in both the governed-financial query and the statement projection, the projection now applying dimension filters as WHERE predicates, and a builder-owned totals query over a derived table with an outer LIMIT 1; validator leaves proving every existing check still fires inside HAVING and the derived table. No provider, chat, Swagger, help or frontend change: those are the next two tasks.
acceptance_criteria: contract/src/measure.ts: MeasureFilterOp (gt|gte|lt|lte), MeasureFilterOperand ({kind:'measure', measureId} | {kind:'value', value}), MeasureFilter and Selection.measureFilters?: MeasureFilter[]; contract/src/api.ts: AskResponse.appliedMeasureFilters?: MeasureFilter[] and the same optional field on ConversationAnswerSnapshot; filters is unchanged; the saved-selection zod schema accepts the field; every shipped leaf that builds or stores a selection passes unmodified and npm run typecheck stays green for all three workspaces.

backend/src/semantic/measure-filter.helper.ts is the ONE seam and canonicaliser, a pure helper with no IO: normalizeMeasureFilters(domain, filters) enforces the value grammar ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$ normalised to exactly two decimals, comparability (measure.format === 'money' on both sides, so both domains' % measures are refused), unknown-measure, self-comparison and duplicate-after-normalisation refusal; operandMeasureIds(selection) returns the union of measureIds and every operand measure id; canonicalizeSelection(domain, selection) normalises and appends operand measures missing from measureIds in first-appearance order, leaving the first entry of measureIds unchanged so row ordering is unchanged.

backend/src/semantic/measure-filter-invalid.exception.ts: MeasureFilterInvalidException extends BadRequestException with reason: MeasureFilterInvalidReason (not_comparable | unknown_measure | self_comparison | duplicate | malformed_value); it is the only shape refusal the helper raises, never a bare Error; an operand outside the user's permissions follows the existing displayed-measure path (validateSelectionForUser 'Measure not available', the executor's SelectionExecutionBlockedError) over the operand union; backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts gains one branch so a MeasureFilterInvalidException answers HTTP 400 with code HTTP_400, type 'MeasureFilterInvalidException', details { reason } and a reader userMessage, pinned by a leaf in error-envelope.wiring.test.ts.

canonicalizeSelection runs at every non-chat ingress this task owns (saved query and pin on store and on reopen, prior-turn re-run) and validateSelectionForUser, the executor's authorize, saved.service.ts and pins.service.ts runnable status and the pin definition-version hash all read operandMeasureIds instead of selection.measureIds; a persisted selection whose operand measure is unregistered or outside the user's permissions reports not runnable exactly as a displayed measure would; leaves prove each site and that a stored selection with the same bad entry as a direct one is refused with the same reason.

backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts renders each measure filter as <left expr> <op> <right expr | lit(value)> joined by AND in a HAVING clause placed after GROUP BY in build and after the projection's grouping in buildStatementProjection; buildStatementProjection additionally renders selection.filters as WHERE predicates on relation.<column> (eq, neq, in) beside the period predicate, emitted only when a filter is present; leaves assert the emitted SQL for measure-vs-measure, measure-vs-value, an ungrouped selection (one aggregate row kept or dropped), the combination with a dimension filter and a time window, and a leaf_key filter on the projection; every existing sqlBuilder and golden statement leaf passes with its expectations unchanged.

A new public SqlBuilder.buildTotals(domain, selection, user, resolvedScope) returns the ungrouped totals query: byte-for-byte today's shape when measureFilters is empty, and 'SELECT <totals over the aliases> FROM (<the grouped, filtered query with no LIMIT>) AS filtered LIMIT 1' when it is not, where a money measure totals as SUM(<alias>), a measure with the new optional MeasureSpec.totalsOverAliases (contract/src/measure.ts, additive) totals through that expression, and any other measure totals as NULL; backend/src/semantic/semanticLayer.ts sets totalsOverAliases on governed-financial.percentage and mis-statement.percentage to the same nil-rule CASE over SUM(actual) and SUM(budget) aliases; selectionExecutor.totalsFor calls buildTotals and constructs no SQL itself; leaves assert the unchanged shape, the money-only shape, the percent-display shape, and that the inner query carries no LIMIT.

backend/src/sql/sqlValidator.ts gains no rule: leaves prove a query with HAVING and the derived-table totals query are accepted, that an unapproved object referenced inside the derived table and a blocked column referenced inside HAVING are refused with the existing reasons, that a missing or oversize outer LIMIT is still refused, and pin that Parser.tableList on the derived table returns the base objects.

Hermetic proof: every required leaf below exists under its exact name, is executed (junit testcase present and executed, never skipped) and passes; python3 factory/scripts/verify.py passes; no file under backend/src/llm, backend/src/chat, backend/src/help, backend/src/conversations or frontend changes.

required_tests.id: normalizeMeasureFilters accepts gt gte lt lte between two money measures and against a decimal value normalised to two decimals
normalizeMeasureFilters refuses a percent operand an unknown measure a self comparison a duplicate entry and a malformed value with typed reasons
canonicalizeSelection appends operand measures in first appearance order and leaves the first measure unchanged
validateSelectionForUser refuses an operand measure outside the domain or the user permissions even when measureIds are permitted
the builder renders a HAVING over the verified expressions for measure versus measure measure versus value and an ungrouped selection with a dimension filter and a time window
buildTotals is unchanged without measure filters and wraps the grouped query without its LIMIT as a derived table with an outer LIMIT 1 when filters are present
buildTotals totals a percent display measure through totalsOverAliases and a money measure as the sum of its alias
a MeasureFilterInvalidException answers HTTP 400 with its type its reason in details and a reader userMessage
the statement projection renders a HAVING for a measure filter and a WHERE predicate for a leaf key filter and is unchanged when neither is present
the validator accepts HAVING and a derived table totals query and still refuses an unapproved object inside the derived table a blocked column inside HAVING and a missing outer LIMIT
saved query runnable status and the stored selection refusal cover the operand measures and answer HTTP 400 with type MeasureFilterInvalidException
pin runnable status and the definition version hash cover the operand measures

reviewer_focus: Constitution first: pnp-coding-standards-modular-monolith.md suffix table for the two new files (helper, exception); 07-exception-handling.md for the typed exception extending BadRequestException with a reason enum, never a bare Error; 03-modular-monolith-structure.md for layout.

ONE seam: backend/src/semantic/measure-filter.helper.ts owns grammar, normalisation, comparability, duplicates, the operand union and the append; validation, executor authorization, saved and pin status and hash CALL it. A second copy of any rule, or a site still reading selection.measureIds alone, is the split-brain this task exists to avoid.

SqlBuilder is the sole SQL author (0004): buildTotals lives in the builder; the executor calls it and constructs no SQL; comparisons render only from measure.expr and lit(value); no string from outside the vocabulary reaches SQL unquoted.

HAVING placement and totals: HAVING after GROUP BY in both domains; the projection's WHERE filters emitted only when present; buildTotals byte-for-byte unchanged when measureFilters is empty so every shipped totals leaf passes unmodified; the derived query carries an outer LIMIT 1 and no inner LIMIT.

Refuse, never drop: a percent operand, an unknown measure, a self-comparison, a duplicate or a malformed value raises MeasureFilterInvalidException with its reason; no code path may proceed with the condition removed.
0028 on reopen: a saved or pinned selection re-canonicalises and re-authorises the operand union as the current user; a revoked operand grant refuses rather than replays.

Scope discipline: no change under backend/src/llm, backend/src/chat (except selectionExecutor.ts and its composed test), backend/src/help, backend/src/conversations or frontend; those belong to the next tasks.
Money crosses the contract as fixed-scale decimal strings normalised to two decimals for compareTo.value; totals keep the shipped number contract.

review_budget.reason: Two contract files, one new helper with its test, one new exception, validation and executor edits, the builder (two domains plus buildTotals), the validator's leaves, saved and pins status and hash with their tests, the composed executor test, and package and quality-gate registration.

tasks.title: Measure comparison filters in Ask: selector schema and prompt, chat ingress and refusal, grounding merge, response and snapshot, Swagger, help, warehouse proof
tasks.objective: Let the selector emit the comparison and let Ask carry it honestly: the Bedrock tool schema enumerates only comparable measure ids in measureFilters, the system prompt maps over/under budget, over 100% and lakh/crore onto the shape and sends anything else to mark_unsupported, the parser refuses malformed entries; for a grounded ask the comparable operands are every money measure of the report's domain the user is permitted (not only the report's displayed measures) so an Actual-only report can answer 'over budget'; the chat service canonicalises the provider's selection and a direct AskRequest.selection through the foundation helper, translates a MeasureFilterInvalidException into responseClass not_supported with a reader sentence per reason and the reason in the structured log line (no audit schema change), emits one chip of the existing kind 'filter' per measure filter, names the comparison in the readback, returns appliedMeasureFilters and snapshots it, marks viewInReport unavailable with the neutral reason, merges the report's and the question's measureFilters in report grounding with identical entries deduplicated, and answers an empty filtered result as a successful zero-row response with the stated message; the chat DTOs and Swagger document the fields; help lists comparison examples; a gated warehouse proof runs the over-budget selection against the July fixture.
acceptance_criteria: backend/src/llm/bedrock.provider.ts: the emit_selection schema gains measureFilters (measureId and compareTo.measureId enumerate ONLY comparable money measure ids of the allowed domains, op enumerates gt|gte|lt|lte, compareTo.value is a string); parseMeasureFilters mirrors parseFilters with typed unsupported reasons in llm.constants.ts; the system prompt gains systemPromptMeasureFilters (comparisons go in measureFilters never filters; over/above/more than budget is Actual gt Budget; under budget is Actual lt Budget; over 100% of budget is Actual gt Budget; 5 lakh -> 500000, 1.2 crore -> 12000000; an unexpressible comparison is mark_unsupported never an unfiltered answer); for a grounded ask the comparable operands are every permitted money measure of the report's domain, not only the report's displayed measures; leaves assert schema, prompt text, parser and an Actual-only grounded report answering 'over budget' with Actual > Budget and Budget appended; the mock provider is unchanged.

backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts canonicalises the provider's selection and a direct AskRequest.selection through the foundation helper before normalisation, validation and execution; a MeasureFilterInvalidException becomes responseClass not_supported with a reader sentence per reason and the reason in the structured log line (no audit schema change); a leaf proves the provider door and the direct door refuse identically.

The chat service emits one chip of the existing kind 'filter' per measure filter with the words label; the provenance readback appends 'where <left label> is greater than / at least / less than / at most <right label or ₹ amount>' per filter; AskResponse.appliedMeasureFilters is returned and conversations.service.ts writes it into the answer snapshot; viewInReport returns available false with the reason 'The MIS statement cannot apply this comparison.' whenever a measure filter is present; applyReportGroundingToSelection merges measureFilters (report's first, identical normalised comparisons deduplicated, the rest ANDed in order) and leaves prove a grounded over-budget question never returns the unfiltered report and that an identical entry on both sides yields one; an empty filtered result is a successful zero-row response with the message 'No lines match <comparison> for <period>'.

The chat DTOs and Swagger document measureFilters, appliedMeasureFilters and the snapshot field with descriptions and examples per pnp-swagger-api-documentation-standards.md; swagger.test.ts passes; backend/src/help/help.service.ts filterExamples gains comparison examples ('Actual more than Budget', 'Actual over 5,00,000').

A gated warehouse leaf backend/src/warehouse/measure-filter.db.test.ts (WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1, registered in test:warehouse-proof and the self-skipping hermetic list, loopback-only) runs Actual, Budget by gl_code with Actual gt Budget for July 2026 against the July fixture and asserts the returned GL codes are exactly the set whose actual exceeds budget, that no under-budget code is present, that a Budget-zero-Actual-positive code is present, and on a fixture with more matching groups than the limit that totals cover the groups beyond the page; executed on the host and recorded in tests.json with its named leaf.

Hermetic proof: every required leaf exists under its exact name, is executed and passes; python3 factory/scripts/verify.py passes; no frontend file changes; every shipped chat, saved, pin and exploration leaf passes unmodified.

tasks.title: Render the comparison: labels, identity, the Ask answer readout line and empty state; live functional check
tasks.objective: Consume the widened contract on the frontend: selection labels render each measure filter in words with registered labels and Indian digit grouping ('Actual > Budget', 'Actual > ₹5,00,000'); selection identity includes measureFilters; the Ask answer shows a read-only readout line under its title built from appliedMeasureFilters and the applied period, on a fresh answer and after a conversation reopen, and renders the empty-state message in place of the blank table when a filtered result has no rows; reopening a saved or pinned selection that carries a filter re-runs it with the filter. Vitest leaves for label, identity, readout, empty state and reopen. The story's functional check runs the executable matrix in the plan live against Bedrock and the July warehouse, as the admin and as a DUB-only user.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/features/exploration/selection-label.ts renders each measure filter as '<left label> <symbol> <right label | ₹ amount>' using SEMANTIC_LABELS and the existing Indian money formatter, with '(unavailable)' for an unregistered id; selection-identity.helper.ts treats two selections differing only in measureFilters (content or order) as distinct.

The Ask answer shows a read-only readout line under its title built from appliedMeasureFilters and the applied period ('Actual > Budget · July 2026') on a fresh answer and after a conversation is reopened, and renders the empty-state message ('No lines match Actual > Budget for July 2026') in place of the blank table when a filtered result has no rows; no control edits the comparison.
Reopening a saved or pinned selection that carries measureFilters re-runs it with the filter and the request body is asserted.

Vitest leaves cover label, identity, readout line, empty state and reopen; every existing exploration and assistant leaf passes unmodified; emil-design-eng and frontend-design are loaded, used and attested.

Functional check, live against Bedrock and the July warehouse, per the plan's executable matrix: as the admin, 'show me list items where Actuals are more than the budget for July 2026' returns only GL codes whose July actual exceeds July budget with the readout 'Actual > Budget · July 2026' and the set equals the governed GL-month relation's over-budget set; 'which GL codes spent more than 5 lakh in July 2026' returns only codes above ₹5,00,000; 'GL codes over 100% of budget for July 2026' returns the same codes as the first; the original no-period phrasing is asked and asserted against its all-loaded scope; as a DUB-only user, 'which statement lines are over budget for July 2026' returns exactly the DUB statement rows whose % is above 100 or reads over-budget; 'GL codes over 100 crore in July 2026' renders the empty-state message.
